---
name: Experiment proposal
about: Propose a new experiment or measurement
title: "E0xx: "
labels: experiment
---

## Goal

What question should this experiment answer?

## Relation to success criterion

How does it advance (or protect) the practical goal of fewer corrective turns?

## Design sketch

- Task construction
- Supervision source (must prefer deterministic)
- Controls / ablations planned
- Evaluation (prefer source-clustered / repository-aware statistics)

## Invariants

Confirm the proposal preserves:

- [ ] Independent encoding of context / question / candidates
- [ ] Lean decision surface
- [ ] No soft / external predicates

## Expected signal

What would count as a positive, negative, or inconclusive result?
